{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify QA orders are still there
print("After conversion, QA orders revenue:", qa_orders['revenue_numeric'].unique())

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
# QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
# Refunded orders: status == 'refunded'
filtered_sales = sales[
    (sales['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99) & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

print("Number of rows after filtering:", len(filtered_sales))

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = filtered_sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Display conversion rates
conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
